ios.desc: Kaien is a slow, gentle app for young children to learn the alphabet. The interface is lowkey, interactions are relaxed, and calm voice feedback is optional.

quotes.text:
Here's mine. It's not big or important (at all!) but I think it is a perfectly valid app that might be useful to some people. It's entirely vibe-coded including code, art and sounds. Only the idea was mine.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kaien/id6759458971
quotes.story_title: So where are all the AI apps?

quotes.text:
Here is my fun mini-project:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kaien/id6759458971

I wanted a way for my kid to learn the alphabet, but without a UI that looks & behaves like a slot machine. It's all maximally slow, relaxed and designed to be easy to put down.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (March 2026)
